messages.author: James Kress
messages.body:
While trying to build pmemd.cuda.MPI with NCCL support the Amber21.pdf
manual says to do this to enable NCCL:
git clone
https://github.com/NVIDIA/nccl.git
cd nccl
git checkout 'git tag | tail -n1'
make src.build CUDA_HOME=/path_to_cuda_toolkit/
The first git works fine.  However, for
git checkout 'git tag | tail -n1'
I get the following error:
fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
Does this mean I do not need to do that git or is there some kind of error
in my following the instructions?
Thanks.
